meera: quick FYI 10:30am bring-up of new reranker candidate on staging showed a weird split: NDCG@10 up ~0.9% but MRR@10 down ~1.3% on the curated holdout. looks like a calibration / discretization artifact rather than real quality drop.
jia: can you share the minimal repro and eval config? topk, holdout size, tokenizer, any PTQ flags?
meera: eval config pasted: topk=10, holdout_size=60k, tokenizer=hf-roberta, quantize=post-training-int8, doc_trunc=2048, query_trunc=64. metrics computed via our harness with default tie handling (stable_sort).
alex: pattern where short queries see stronger MRR drop while NDCG rises often points to score collisions at rank1. stable_sort tie-breaker lets retrieval order decide the top hit which makes MRR jumpy.
sam: suggest three quick experiments: (A) change tie strategy to average (bucket ties and average ranks), (B) random tie-break with fixed seed, (C) inspect raw score distribution for discrete clusters.
meera: ran small local runs on 12k queries:
- stable (current): MRR -1.28% (p=0.025), NDCG +0.92%
- avg ties: MRR -0.12% (p=0.44), NDCG +0.88%
- random(seed=123): MRR -0.09% (p=0.46), NDCG +0.90%
so avg/random eliminate the apparent MRR regression.
lucy: also check label pooling: our webqa holdout has many pooled equivalents for short queries (duplicate urls or snippets). If gold contains multiple equivalent docs, MRR is sensitive to which candidate gets top1.
jeval-bot: ci-run 1739995555 finished: ndcg_delta:+0.90% mrr_delta:-1.31% bootstrap_p(mrr)=0.022 (1000 resamples). full artifact: /ci/artifacts/1739995555.json
ajex: (typo) alex: we should add a small metric to the harness: tie_fraction = fraction of queries with >=2 identical topk scores. if tie_fraction > 0.03, fail the strict MRR regression check or mark as "tie-sensitive".
sam: agreed. proposed changes: default offline eval tie strategy -> avg, keep production serving deterministic (stable). add tie_fraction logging, and add alerting when tie_fraction increases by >2x vs baseline. also add histogram of score quantization buckets to the CI artifact.
jia: please also log per-length-bin tie_fraction (short/mid/long) since we saw short queries disproportionately affected.
meera: i'll open PRs: (1) eval-harness: tie_strategy flag with default=avg for CI, tie_fraction calculation, histograms; (2) ops: dashboard panel for tie_fraction and bucketed score histogram; (3) ci: relax MRR gating when tie_fraction>threshold but still fail if NDCG drops. assigning owners: meera->PR+run full holdout, alex->dashboard, sam->CI rule.
alex: tiny follow-up experiment: try length-normalized score: score_norm = score / (1 + alpha*doc_len_tokens) with alpha=0.05 to test long-doc bias interplay. if that reduces tie_mass, it might indicate length-related rounding.
lucy: note for release notes: "Evaluation harness: switched offline default tie handling to averaged ranks to reduce spurious MRR regressions caused by score discretization (PTQ/quantization). Added tie_fraction telemetry and CI heuristics."
sam: one more operational note: if we do change offline default, we should re-evaluate historical baselines (rolling 90-day) to avoid flip-flopping alerts. add a migration job to recompute key baselines with avg ties.
meera: will include migration in PR description. thanks all. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks — please attach sample score histogram and top-20 tie examples in the PR for reviewers.
meera: attaching in PR. end.
